situations.title: 중심 체온 지속 감시
situations.tagline: Let's keep a continuous core temp reading on her throughout the case.
situations.brief: 수술 내내 중심 체온을 지속적으로 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's monitor her core temperature continuously.
I'll watch for any downward trend.
Keeping her normothermic is the goal.

situations.title: 가온 담요 적용
situations.tagline: Let's get the forced-air warming blanket on before we lose any body heat.
situations.brief: forced-air 가온 담요를 적용해 체온을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's place the forced-air warmer now.
Active warming keeps her temperature up.
I'll set it to the appropriate temperature.

situations.title: 가온 수액 적용
situations.tagline: Let's run her IV fluids through the fluid warmer to prevent heat loss.
situations.brief: 수액을 가온하여 투여해 열손실을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's warm the IV fluids before infusing.
Cold fluids drop the core temperature fast.
I'll set up the fluid warmer now.

situations.title: 실내 온도 조정
situations.tagline: Can we bump the room temperature up a couple degrees before we bring the patient in?
situations.brief: 수술실 온도를 조정해 환자의 열손실을 줄이세요.
keyPhrases: Let's raise the room temperature a bit.
A warmer room reduces the patient's heat loss.
We can adjust once the case is underway.

situations.title: 노출 최소화
situations.tagline: Let's keep her covered as much as we can and only expose the surgical site.
situations.brief: 환자의 노출을 최소화해 체온 손실을 줄이세요.
keyPhrases: Let's keep everything but the site covered.
Minimizing exposure conserves body heat.
I'll add warm blankets where I can.

situations.title: 입실 기저 체온 확인
situations.tagline: I've been freezing in this waiting room — is my temperature okay?
situations.brief: 입실 시 기저 체온을 확인하고 환자와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check your temperature before we go in.
I'll get you a warm blanket right away.
We'll keep you warm and comfortable during surgery.

situations.title: 장시간 수술 저체온 위험
situations.tagline: This case is going to run long — let's stay ahead of hypothermia from the start.
situations.brief: 장시간 수술에서 저체온 위험을 선제적으로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Long cases put her at higher risk for hypothermia.
Let's use every warming measure we have.
I'll trend her temperature every fifteen minutes.

situations.title: 세척액 가온
situations.tagline: Let's make sure the irrigation fluid is warmed before the surgeon uses it.
situations.brief: 세척액을 가온하여 사용해 체온 손실을 막으세요.
keyPhrases: Let's warm the irrigation fluid first.
Cold irrigation cools the body cavity fast.
I'll keep warmed bottles ready for the surgeon.

situations.title: 소아 저체온 취약
situations.tagline: She's so small — kids lose heat fast, so let's be aggressive with warming.
situations.brief: 소아 환자는 저체온에 취약하므로 적극적으로 체온을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Children lose body heat much faster than adults.
Let's warm the room and use active warming early.
I'll monitor her temperature very closely.

situations.title: 노인 열손실 대비
situations.tagline: He's elderly with low muscle mass — he'll lose heat quickly, so let's prep warming now.
situations.brief: 노인 환자의 열손실에 대비해 미리 가온을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Older patients are prone to rapid heat loss.
Let's pre-warm before induction.
I'll keep active warming on throughout.

situations.title: 대량 수혈 저체온
situations.tagline: We're transfusing a lot of units — let's run them through the warmer to avoid dropping her temp.
situations.brief: 대량 수혈 시 혈액을 가온해 저체온을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's warm all the blood products.
Rapid cold transfusion drops core temperature.
I'll keep the fluid warmer running.

situations.title: 체온 하강 추세 보고
situations.tagline: Her core temp's dropped to 35.4 and still trending down — I'm flagging it to the team.
situations.brief: 체온 하강 추세를 감지하고 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Her temperature is trending down — now 35.4.
I'm escalating our warming measures.
Let's reassess in ten minutes.

situations.title: 마취 열재분포 대비
situations.tagline: Right after induction her temp will drop from redistribution — let's pre-warm to blunt it.
situations.brief: 마취 유도 후 열재분포에 대비해 사전 가온하세요.
keyPhrases: Heat redistributes right after induction.
Pre-warming reduces that initial drop.
Let's warm her before we go under.

situations.title: 개복 노출 열손실
situations.tagline: With the abdomen open this long, she's losing a lot of heat — let's cover and warm what we can.
situations.brief: 개복으로 인한 열손실을 줄이도록 노출을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The open abdomen is a major source of heat loss.
Let's cover exposed areas and warm the room.
I'll keep the forced-air warmer maximized.

situations.title: 목표 정상체온 유지
situations.tagline: Let's keep her above 36 degrees the whole case — that's our normothermia target.
situations.brief: 목표 정상체온을 설정하고 수술 내내 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Our target is to keep her above 36 degrees.
Normothermia lowers infection and bleeding risk.
Let's maintain active warming to hit that goal.

situations.title: 중증 저체온 응고장애
situations.tagline: She's at 33 degrees and starting to ooze everywhere — hypothermia's hitting her coagulation.
situations.brief: 중증 저체온으로 인한 응고장애를 인지하고 재가온을 강화하세요.
keyPhrases: Her hypothermia is impairing coagulation.
Let's aggressively rewarm and warm all products.
I'll alert the team about the bleeding risk.

situations.title: 저체온 부정맥 발생
situations.tagline: Her rhythm's getting irregular as she cools — this could be hypothermia-driven, let's rewarm fast.
situations.brief: 저체온으로 인한 부정맥을 인지하고 즉시 재가온하세요.
keyPhrases: The arrhythmia may be from her low temperature.
Let's rewarm aggressively and monitor the rhythm.
Keep the crash cart close by.

situations.title: shivering 산소요구 급증
situations.tagline: He's shivering hard now and his oxygen demand is spiking — we need to control this fast.
situations.brief: shivering으로 산소요구가 급증한 환자를 즉시 중재하세요.
keyPhrases: Shivering is driving his oxygen demand way up.
Let's actively warm him and consider medication.
Increase his oxygen and watch his saturation.

situations.title: 재가온 실패 지속 저하
situations.tagline: We've maxed out warming and her temp still won't come up — she keeps dropping.
situations.brief: 재가온에 실패하고 체온이 지속 저하하는 상황에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Despite maximal warming, her temp keeps falling.
Let's look for an underlying cause.
We may need advanced rewarming methods.

situations.title: 저체온 심정지 위험
situations.tagline: She's down to 30 degrees and bradycardic — we're on the edge of a hypothermic arrest.
situations.brief: 저체온으로 인한 심정지 위험에 대비해 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: She's at high risk for a hypothermic cardiac arrest.
Let's rewarm aggressively and prep for a code.
Handle her gently — cold hearts are irritable.

situations.title: 과가온 고체온 대응
situations.tagline: We overdid the warming — she's up to 38.5 now, so let's back off and cool her down.
situations.brief: 과도한 가온으로 인한 고체온을 인지하고 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: We've overshot — her temp is climbing too high.
Let's reduce the active warming now.
I'll monitor for any signs of overheating.
